crossRefs.note: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
“Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
“Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

translations.web: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
translations.bsb: when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.
translations.kjv: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
translations.asv: When he gave to the sea its bound, That the waters should not transgress his commandment, When he marked out the foundations of the earth;
